pages.title: Breckenridge (Colorado)
pages.description: town in and county seat of Summit County, Colorado, United States
pages.extract: Breckenridge is a ski resort and town at the northern tip of the south central region of Colorado, in the Rocky Mountains of the United States of America.  It is the prototype of the Western Slope resort cities that have developed following the explosive growth of the ski industry in Colorado.

pages.title: Cheviot Hills
pages.extract:
Cheviot Hills form the border between England and Scotland, with most sites of visitor interest in Northumberland in England. See Kirk Yetholm for their portion within Scotland.
Large tracts of these hills are now within a national park, bisected by A68, and this page describes areas on or east of that highway, with Otterburn and Rothbury the largest villages. 
Northumberland National Park describes the area west of A68, focussed on Bellingham and Kielder Forest.

pages.title: Freedom Trail
pages.description: historical walking trail in Boston, Massachusetts
pages.extract: To travel back to Revolutionary Boston—to understand the people, the events, and the ideals of the 1700s—is a great leap for us today. But the sites along the Freedom Trail speak eloquently of that time. Bostonians and other colonists shared a notion of liberty as something precious and worth fighting for. The Freedom Trail sites include the scenes of critical events in Boston's and the nation's struggle for freedom. Some visitors choose to trek the entire 2.5 mile route or select an individual site to visit at length, while others experience the Freedom Trail as a cohesive story built around four chapters, organized along geographic and thematic lines.

pages.title: Hamilton Island
pages.description: island in Whitsunday Region, Queensland, Australia
pages.extract: Hamilton Island is one of the Whitsunday Islands of Central Queensland. It is part of the Great Barrier Reef. The island has been developed as a popular holiday resort, and made waves in 2008 when it advertised the caretaker's position as the Best Job in the World — $150,000 for six months of living on the island and blogging about it once a week.

pages.title: Massillon
pages.description: city in Stark County, Ohio, United States

pages.title: Mwanza
pages.extract: Mwanza is a city in Northwest Tanzania on the southern edge of Lake Victoria. Your main reason for coming here would likely be en route to Rwanda or Uganda. The city received some international attention after the controversial documentary Darwin's Nightmare, which is about the trade in the Nile Perch, centered in this city.

pages.title: Peneda-Gerês National Park
pages.extract: Peneda-Gerês National Park (Portuguese: Parque Nacional da Peneda-Gerês) is a national park in Portugal and is the only national park in Portugal, covering an area of 695.93 km2 (268.70 sq mi).

pages.title: Raub
pages.extract: Raub, is one of the oldest towns in the State of Pahang. It began as a gold mining town in the early 19th century. Remnants of its colonial past are evident in the old buildings around the town.

pages.title: Ravenna (Ohio)
pages.description: city in Portage County, Ohio, United States
pages.extract: Ravenna is a city of 11,000 people (2019) in and the seat of Portage County.

pages.title: Zunil
pages.extract: Zunil is a small, mostly agricultural village in Guatemala.

pages.title: Palayan
pages.description: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Nueva Ecija
pages.extract: Palayan is the capital city of Nueva Ecija province in the Philippines.

pages.title: Tempio Pausania
pages.extract: Tempio Pausania is a town of about 14,000 inhabitants in the Gallura region of Sassari province in northern Sardinia, Italy.

pages.title: Santa Isabel (Puerto Rico)
pages.extract: Santa Isabel is a small seaside town and municipality of Puerto Rico located along the island's Caribbean coast, famous for its agricultural history and, more recently, its racehorse stud farms.

pages.title: Okota
pages.description: residential and commercial area in Lagos state

pages.title: Central Kalahari Game Reserve
pages.description: national park in the Kalahari desert of Botswana

pages.title: TAZARA Railway
pages.extract: The TAZARA Railway is Africa's most epic train journey. Yes, there are destinations – namely Kapiri Mposhi in Zambia and Dar es Salaam in Tanzania – or somewhere in between. You'll get there eventually. But getting there isn't really the point. You ride the TAZARA for the sake of the riding the TAZARA. And in doing so you'll cross some of the most exotic and hard-to-reach areas of the world.

pages.title: Suakin
pages.description: port in north-eastern Sudan on the west coast of the Red Sea

pages.title: Amboró National Park
pages.extract: Amboró National Park (or Parque Nacional Amboró in Spanish) is a protected natural area in the central Sub-Andean region of Bolivia. It is challenging terrain that is difficult to reach and explore. The park is in the transitional Yungas zone of foothills of the Andes mountains. It is an area that within a very short distance can change from highland cloud forests to lowland dry forests. Astounding biodiversity can be found throughout the park with thousands of plant species, more than 900 bird species, and almost 200 kinds of mammal.

pages.title: Omeo
pages.extract: Omeo is a small town of 411 (2021) in Victoria's East Gippsland region. It sits close to the snowline and one of the only towns on the eastern end of the Victorian Alps. It is mainly a service town along the Great Alpine Road, thus having very little to see but plenty of accommodation options.

pages.title: Itapevi
pages.description: municipality of São Paulo state, Brazil
pages.extract:
Itapevi, also known as Itacity, City of Roses, City of New Roofs or City of Hope, is a city in the São Paulo Metropolitan Region, in the state of São Paulo. It is one of the largest biotechnology centers and pharmaceutical industry in the country in Brazil.

With a population of almost 250,000 people in 2025, it is the 4th most populous in the western part of the metropolitan region.
